top_band: light tan/sandstone flat roof terrace with parapet wall, rug and trapdoor, rows 1-31
evidence: Rows 1-31 show a horizontal flat roof terrace from above (with parapet inner shadow at rows 3-5, a rug, a ladder hatch, and front parapet rim/edge highlight at rows 28-31). Rows 32-33 form the dark overhang/cornice shadow, and rows 34-63 show the vertical south wall with recessed beam holes, inset arched wooden door, and inset lattice window.

style.evidence: The adobe walls and roof terrace use 5-6 warm earth/sand tones with abundant plaster speckle, exposed brick patches, timber beam ends, a detailed rug, and a patterned lattice window. Outlines are dark brown material tones matching the Beodeul reference craft.
